blocks.html: The details of the cart items with inventory result computed for the specified input.

types.name: items
types.description: The cart's line items with the computed inventory result.

children.name: inventory_item_id
children.description: The ID of the inventory item used to retrieve the item's available quantity.

children.name: required_quantity
children.description:
The number of units a single quantity is equivalent to. For example, if a customer orders one quantity of the variant, Medusa checks the availability of the quantity multiplied by the
value set for `required_quantity`. When the customer orders the quantity, Medusa reserves the ordered quantity multiplied by the value set for `required_quantity`.

children.name: allow_backorder
children.description: Whether the variant can be ordered even if it's out of stock. If a variant has this enabled, the workflow doesn't throw an error.

children.name: quantity
children.description: The quantity in the cart. If you provided `itemsToUpdate` in the input, this will be the updated quantity.

children.name: location_ids
children.description: The ID of the stock locations that the computed inventory quantity is available in.
